# Abadi

> An ERC-4626 vault that makes markets on DreamDEX Event Contracts, on Somnia Shannon
> testnet (chain eip155:50312). It rests a two-sided quote inside the incumbent's spread
> while holding no inventory: two opposite-side buys cross with no seller, the pool mints
> the pair, and a complete set redeems for exactly 1 whichever way the window resolves.

Every number this project publishes is read from the chain. Where a figure is a loss it is
still published; the ledger is built to be unable to hide one, because it was caught hiding
two.

## What it is

- Vault: `0xF5571c653B142B87BB552FB212e244bd80693f24`, ERC-4626, 6 decimals, shares `abLIQ`
- Asset: `0x70a86D8842FB63C4Ad2b7cdddF530eBf1BB25d8E` (tUSDC, 6 decimals, has no `permit`)
- Source is verified on the Shannon explorer, and `node scripts/attest.ts` compares the
  deployed bytecode against this repo's artifact and prints MATCH or the difference.
- The operator key chooses a price and a size. It cannot move a token, and no function
  exists that would let it. Custody rules are in `src/LiquidityVault.sol`.

## Machine-readable

- /deployments.json — addresses, chain in CAIP-2, every retired deployment and why
- /abi.json — the vault's ABI, generated from the compiled artifact at build time
- /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt — the four pages, generated from the same list that builds them
- /.well-known/security.txt — RFC 9116, where to report something against these contracts
- The vault's 60 custom errors and the venue's ABIs are uploaded to the public signature
  databases, so a revert from either decodes in `cast 4byte`, Foundry traces and
  Blockscout. See docs/evidence/selectors-2026-09-06.md.

## Pages

- / — what the mechanism is, with a control that shows the pair summing to 1 at any price
- /dashboard — the live order book with this vault's own quote marked in it by owner
  address, the equity curve, and every episode the vault has run, decoded from the
  explorer in the reader's browser
- /app — deposit, withdraw, mint test collateral
- /deck — the argument in ten slides

## What it measured

- Rebuilding 70 quoted windows twice from the venue's own order rows, with this vault's
  orders and without: mean spread 0.0249 without, 0.0192 with. Tighter on 66 of 70, wider
  on none. Dated 2026-08-31, in docs/evidence/impact-2026-08-31.txt.
- One leg filling while the market walks away from the other is the real cost. 26 such
  episodes carried to settlement averaged -30.12% of basis; 14 closed by crossing the book
  for the missing side averaged -0.98%. docs/evidence/completing-2026-09-06.md.
- The vault is down. Per share 0.967282 on 2026-09-07 12:45 UTC, -3.27% against par: 312.99
  tUSDC below what depositors put in, across 223 episodes on 13 vaults. 21% of filled quotes
  went adverse where the spread needs under about 9%. docs/evidence/ledger-2026-09-07.md.

## Repository

https://github.com/PugarHuda/abadi — contracts in src/, the keeper in scripts/bot.ts, the
site in web/, browser tests in qa/, and one file per thing that happened in docs/evidence/,
including the things that went wrong and what they cost.

## Two things a reader should know before quoting this

- The operator key cannot transfer collateral out, and it CAN trade it away — it picks the
  market, the price and the size. The two caps that bound that are set on chain since
  2026-09-06: 500 tUSDC of escrow per quote, 2500 bps of NAV across the book.
- `node scripts/attest.ts` says MATCH: the deployed bytecode is this source. It did not for
  two days, while three guards lived in `src/` and not on chain; the vault was redeployed on
  2026-09-07 and they are on chain now.
